fields.help: Local agent runtime to use (e.g. claude), or jev / jev:<model> to score with Jev (the default decision provider, TypeSafe unless you chose another), or jev@<provider> / jev@<provider>:<model> for a provider added with monoagentcli jev provider add: one request answers the gates and rubric dimensions and the verdict is computed with the same weights and bands. TypeSafe needs the vault secret typesafe or TYPESAFE_API_KEY (no fallback)； the job posting and profile excerpts are sent to the provider.
